name: Pininfarina
verdict: Part of the Mahindra Group since 2016 (Tech Mahindra-led consortium bought 76.06% in 2015). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Mahindra Group companies (private/listed, India and Italy); no state in the chain. A Tech Mahindra/Mahindra & Mahindra consortium agreed to buy 76.06% of Pininfarina S.p.A. in 2015; Pininfarina's own site says it is 'part of the Mahindra galaxy since 2016'. No human-rights finding against the company identified.
